newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Feb fiscal deficit $283 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Feb fiscal deficit $283 mln.

text.p: Argentina posted a $283 million fiscal deficit in February, up from a $228 shortfall in February 1996 and a $276 million deficit in January 1997, the Economy Ministry said Monday.

However, the February deficit grows to $384 million if the negative impact of the transfer of provincial pension funds to the central government and compensation to workers made redundant under a labor reform program are factored in.
The deficit in the first two months of the year not including pension fund transfers or redundacy payments was $559 million. Including those expenses, it was $803 million.
Argentina has agreed with the International Monetary Fund on a first quarter shortfall of $1.04 billion, or $1.64 billion including pension funds and redundancy payments.
Argentina and the IMF have agreed on a deficit of $3.0 billion for 1997, or $4.5 billion including pension funds and redundancy payments.
